{"id": "348f9178-ca73-48fa-8e75-93df5790e976", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "I couldn't find a Bedrock agent in us-east-1 in the only account I can see (123456789012), so I haven't confirmed anything about your agent yet. The agent may be in a different account or Region, or it may be an AgentCore runtime instead of a classic Bedrock Agent. Below are the checks I'd run, most likely cause first.

**1. Check which version the production alias serves.**
- The console test usually runs the draft through the test alias. Production calls go through an alias that points at a specific numbered version.
- Preparing a new version yesterday doesn't change what production serves. An alias only moves if it was updated.
- Run `get_agent_alias` or `list_agent_aliases` and look at the `routingConfiguration` version.
- The usual cause is that the alias still serves an older version, or serves a new version that was created from a different draft than the one you tested.
- Compare the old and new versions on instructions, foundation model, prompt overrides, action groups and guardrail.
